response.sql: SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Transactions with type other than 'PRIJEM' or 'VYDAJ' (such as 'VYBER') are included in the average balance calculation but excluded from the signed amount calculation, since 'other types ignored' is stated only for the signed amount metric.

alternatives.interpretation: Completely exclude all transactions with type other than 'PRIJEM' or 'VYDAJ' from both calculations, restricting analysis to only those two types.
alternatives.sql: SELECT t.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.amount >= 2400 AND t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency ORDER BY avg_balance DESC LIMIT 10;
